_comment: Cup draws done by hand (e.g. live in the chat). A round listed in `hold` is NOT drawn automatically: the Cup waits until its fixtures appear under `manual`. Give each pairing as two personKeys (home first), e.g. "round1": [["carmine", "zac"], ["ostap", "pat"], ...]. Once a round has been drawn it is saved in cup.json and never redrawn.
